themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe, Latin America, and the UK are asserting strong electoral momentum through major campaign rallies, high-profile poll leads, and early re-election bids. Leaders are framing upcoming votes as existential choices between national revival and leftist or establishment decline.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal mobilizes thousands in Murcia ahead of November 29 elections, framing the vote as 'Spain or the mafia.'

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen holds firm poll leads for 2027 while party officials launch nationwide mayoral signature collection drives.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Sylvi Listhaug kickstarts campaign offensive, building on strong polling outside major urban centers.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei officially confirms his 2027 re-election bid and sets long-term global trade expansion goals through 2031.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Consolidates local council presence in municipal by-elections and advances internal party restructuring.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Maintains federal polling strength and nominates high-profile candidate Thomas Berthold for the presidency.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Launches major economic program convention in Katowice to lay the groundwork for returning to power.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements are intensifying demands for strict border enforcement, 'remigration,' and the prioritization of native citizens over migrants in public assistance. Parties are leveraging local grievances to push hardline anti-immigration proposals into mainstream political debates.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Campaigns on 'prioridad nacional' and remigration proposals across local municipalities like Puertollano and Ciudad Rodrigo.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Escalates attacks on government border policies and asylum accommodation while demanding immediate migration cutbacks.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump allies push strict immigration enforcement and reduced federal benefit access for non-citizens.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Faces ongoing political debate and scrutiny over its embrace of 'remigration' policy language.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Demands stricter deportation enforcement and tightens conditions for Swedish integration and citizenship.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Prominent right-wing figures and parties face heightened legal scrutiny, judicial investigations, and potential ban petitions across several nations. In response, conservative and populist leaders accuse judicial authorities of political bias and weaponization.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Authorities uncover $20 million in hidden cash linked to an Orbán-era minister, sparking intense legal probes and political fallout.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Supreme Court judges demand security details on Jair Bolsonaro while upholding legal penalties against key political allies.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Protesters and political opponents demand constitutional court review and potential ban procedures against the party.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Administration lawyers and cabinet nominees face persistent judicial oversight and ethics inquiries.

themes.title: Anti-Establishment Hostility to Public Media and Information Control
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders are challenging government regulations on digital platforms and media censorship, positioning themselves as defenders of free expression against state overreach. Presidential vetoes and public attacks frame judicial and executive digital controls as authoritarian.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: President Karol Nawrocki vetoes a digital services bill, claiming state blocking of online content amounts to censorship.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Right-wing figures criticize Supreme Court blockades targeting journalists and highlight press freedom disputes.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini rejects preventive digital censorship mechanisms while Giorgia Meloni utilizes direct social broadcasts to bypass mainstream media.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Populist leaders are increasingly engaging in parallel foreign policy initiatives to bypass traditional diplomatic channels and establish alternative international alignments. Parties cite foreign ideological allies as models while attempting to reframe national defense positions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen proposes direct bilateral talks with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy in Brussels outside official French executive channels.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage launches a security policy review designating Russia as Britain's top threat to counter allegations of pro-Putin sentiment.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Explicitly highlights Marine Le Pen's Rassemblement National as the foreign political model for Spanish conservative strategy.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump proposes an unprecedented trilateral diplomatic summit with Chinese and Russian leaders on Middle East conflicts.
